name: Chthonic-Gnomon
description: This is a world of broad skies and long sightlines, its map written in massive canyon systems. Travelers navigate by an orbital debris ring and by nothing else, because nothing else stands still.
In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless.
Local legend among spacers says the planet hums on a frequency just below hearing. Instruments confirm it. Nobody agrees on the source.
Every syndicate scout files the same advice: harvest fast, land light, and never spend a full cycle planetside. The wise ones follow it exactly once.
